dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual linear narrowing of the visible dorsal mass from the lower-frame mid-body toward the upper-frame peduncle region.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse dark-grey mottling distributed across the posterior-most visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the light-grey baseline and darker mottled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One distinct, high-contrast dark circular mark located on the central dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a single, well-defined dark circular mark/lesion on the mid-dorsal surface.
